name: gramkit
description: Video speed, seek and volume controls, keyboard shortcuts, downloads and focus tools for Instagram on the web. Chrome, Zen and Firefox.

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --firefox /Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen --start-url https://www.instagram.com/
scripts.start:chrome: npm run build && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist/chrome --start-url https://www.instagram.com/
scripts.submit:firefox: npm run build && npm run source && web-ext sign --channel listed --source-dir dist/firefox --upload-source-code dist/gramkit-source-$npm_package_version.zip --amo-metadata store/amo-metadata.json --approval-timeout 0
